common.selection: Both r00/r01 families, shutdown/context_reset, all statuses/target slots, unfinished task, remaining=2, both matched variants and both role assignments.
common.scope_limit: 24 independent generated identity cases, 48 notice variants, 96 role observations. Two authored hard wording families. A third reporter is outside the two candidate identities; the true subject is guaranteed to be one candidate.

field_reference.purpose: Primary canonical role contrast; report all direct and contrast variants without selecting the best.

explicit_identity.purpose: Required strong explicit-ID semantic-mean baseline and all corresponding role contrasts.

required_reporting: Independent raw-score audit plus matched control/hard tables, complete-case correctness, frequency/first-candidate/last-candidate baselines and a grammar-aware ceiling. All abstentions and all notice variants stay visible.
